newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil barges jump on buying, swap strength.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil barges jump on buying, swap strength.

text.p: NWE fuel barges rose sharply on Friday on the back of buying by one major and higher swaps values, traders said.
One player bought around 15,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil barges at $83 and $83.50 fob ARA, $1 to $2 higher than Thursday's limited trade.
Some traders said bunker market demand improved from midweek lows, but attributed the physical price gains to the strength of May swaps, up to $84/$84.50.
Others were puzzled by the big buying, speculating it was related to a paper position.
"There is no real reason for the market to go up today," said one trader.
Most other markets were very quiet, with much of Europe taking the Friday as a holiday.
There was some bunker demand reported for Las Palmas, with little of the correct grade seen available to fill it.
